info.title: Steam4Caster API
info.description:
Backend API for **Steam4Caster**: probabilistic Steam discount forecasts, explainable
BUY / WAIT / NEUTRAL recommendations, watchlists and alerts.

* All public routes are versioned under `/api/v1`.
* Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`.
* Money is always integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 currency, per region. Prices are
  never converted between currencies.
* Errors use one envelope: `{"error": {"code", "message", "correlation_id", "details"}}`.
* Forecasts and recommendations are statistical estimates based on past prices. They are not guarantees and not financial advice.

Price data is provided by the IsThereAnyDeal API. Steam4Caster is not affiliated with
IsThereAnyDeal or Valve.

patch.description: Only fields present in the body are changed. Send an explicit null to clear target_price_minor, min_discount_pct or max_wait_days.
Fields present in each item are applied. Quiet hours are interpreted in the item's IANA timezone; alerts raised during quiet hours are delivered afterwards.

active.description: Null when no ML model is active and the deterministic baseline is in use.

historical_low_total.description: Total if every game were bought at its lowest recorded regional price.

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Modelled totals if each game is bought at its expected price within the horizon. Estimates only.

cutoff_at.title: Cutoff At
cutoff_at.description: No price data after this instant was used.

method.title: Method
method.description: BASELINE or ML: the method that actually produced this.

sale_probability.description: Estimated probability the game is discounted at any point in the horizon.

new_sale_probability.description: Estimated probability a new sale starts in the horizon.

discount_tier_probabilities.title: Discount Tier Probabilities
discount_tier_probabilities.description: Distribution over ['LT_20', '20_TO_29', '30_TO_39', '40_TO_49', '50_TO_59', '60_TO_74', '75_PLUS'], conditional on a sale.

predicted_sale_price.description: Estimated sale-price interval, conditional on a sale occurring.

likely_window.description: Only present when the evidence is concentrated enough to give one.

outcome.description: What actually happened, filled in once horizons expire.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.default: Forecasts and recommendations are statistical estimates based on past prices. They are not guarantees and not financial advice.

example.disclaimer: Forecasts and recommendations are statistical estimates based on past prices. They are not guarantees and not financial advice.

explanation_factors.text: Sales have historically started every 45–60 days.

items.title: Items
items.description: Price *changes* in chronological order (a step series, not samples).

Money.title: Money
Money.description:
An amount in integer minor units with its ISO 4217 currency. ``amount`` is a
decimal string for display; clients must not parse it into binary floats.

available.title: Available
available.description: Whether the server has this channel configured.

destination_masked.title: Destination Masked
destination_masked.description: Masked destination for SMS; email and push use the account/browser.

vapid_public_key.title: Vapid Public Key
vapid_public_key.description: applicationServerKey for PushManager.subscribe(); null if push is off.

observed_at.title: Observed At
observed_at.description: When the provider last saw this price change.

attribution.affiliation: Steam4Caster is not affiliated with or endorsed by IsThereAnyDeal or Valve.
attribution.text: Price data provided by the IsThereAnyDeal API.

sale_probability.title: Sale Probability
sale_probability.description: Estimated probability of a new sale within max_wait_days.

expected_savings.description: Estimated; may be zero or negative.

example.summary: There is an estimated 72% chance of a new sale starting within 60 days, with an expected saving of about INR 584.00. This is a statistical estimate, not a guarantee or financial advice.

ended_at.title: Ended At
ended_at.description: Null while the sale is still running.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of target_price_minor; must match the region's.

current.description: Null until a regional price is known.

totals.title: Totals
totals.description: One block per currency. Amounts are never summed across currencies.

disclaimer.default: Forecasts and recommendations are statistical estimates based on past prices. They are not guarantees and not financial advice.
